name: Index-Dependent Asymmetric Determinant Obfuscation
description: Modified the characteristic matrix so its determinant evaluates to `(s_u - s_v)(s_u^2 - s_v^2 + u + v + 10)`. This introduces the node indices `u` and `v` into the matrix, breaking the ability to precompute a simple 3x3 compatibility table for the colors. The second factor is strictly positive, so the roots remain exactly `s_u = s_v`, preserving the 3-coloring reduction. The asymmetry and index-dependence will prevent models from easily reducing it to a standard graph coloring library call, forcing them to either write a custom backtracking solver or attempt complex symbolic analysis.
